answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150221 Country: INDIA Title: Is Faaz Ali Hassan right name or not please give me a suggestion for my nephew? His father’s name is Md Imtiyaz Ali. Question: Is Faaz Ali Hassan right name or not please give me a suggestion for my nephew? His father’s name is Md Imtiyaz Ali. Answer ID: 150221 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 937/905/M=7/1438) Instead of Faaz Ali keep the name Faiz Ali or Fauzan Ali. The word Faaz is not suitable to name someone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
